message:
test(cuda): keep allocation probes aligned with retained shell metadata

Add shell_ao_offsets to the shared HostBatch/DeviceBatch test stub. Reproduced 12 compilation setup errors before this change; all 12 optional-allocation and stack-reservation failure-isolation tests pass afterward. No production path or assertion is weakened.

docs: install from the demonstrated CUDA preset build directory

The cuda-dev-fast configure/build commands use build/cuda-dev-fast according to CMakePresets.json. Keep the following SDK install command on the same binary directory instead of the unconfigured build root.
